description: This file defines the 'NoteService' interface in Java for managing note objects, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Interface for note management operations, including create, findAll, findById, update, and deleteById.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided create request.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note with provided fields.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a note specified by its id.
